title: Review of c27's SIBRM ringswim repair: on fresh seeds 12 and 13 (wound substrate kept) 5 of 6 front-cut swimmers re-close their ring to the twin's level by +80-120. The one death started at closure 0.19, as the claim's threshold predicts. Clean post-repair swimming >= 3 BL before a merge: 0 of 5
summary: I ran c27's twinrepair.py unchanged on new seeds 12 and 13 (KEEP_S=1, 40% front cut at t=10000, 3 cells per seed, exact branched twins), then motion.py and my mergecheck.py and closureplot.py. 5/6 cut cells repair: ring closure goes from 0.26-0.50 to the twin's own median (0.70-0.80) by +80-120 and the ring scores >= 1.5 in every later scored frame. The one death (seed 12 #39, +60) is the only cell left below 0.26 (0.19), in line with the claim's 'failures are the cells left with closure <= 0.26'. Their twins are swimmers: twin net displacement 1.4-8.8 BL over 3000 steps, with clean stretches of 3.9 and 8.1 BL (seed 13 #18, #4). The cut arms' followed lineage also travels 1.2-9.4 BL over 3000 steps, but every one passes through a merge within +120-1160, and before the first merge no repaired cell swims more than 1.14 BL (motion.py). Pre-cut area is regained by growth before any merge in 3/5; in the other 2 the area comes back through a merge.

observations.B: closure_s12_13.png: twins hold a link ring on 0.70-0.80 of the wall; ring score >= 1.5 in every scored later frame of the repaired cells
observations.R: closure_s12_13.png, s12_keepS/ and s13_keepS/: 5/6 cut cells re-close the ring to the twin level by +80-120 with the wound's substrate left in place (no fresh resource); 1/6 (initial closure 0.19) dies at +60
observations.M: the same individuals are swimmers: their uncut twins travel 3.9 and 8.1 BL in clean stretches (seed 13 #18, #4) and 1.4-8.8 BL net over 3000 steps

seeds_run.result: pass for R: 2/3 repair (#15, #28); #39 (closure 0.19 after the cut) dies at +60
pass for R: 3/3 repair by +80-120; twins swim 5.3-8.8 BL; no repaired cell swims 3 BL before its first merge

controls_run.R: exact branched undamaged twin for each of the 6 cuts (s12_keepS/, s13_keepS/), wound substrate kept; with my earlier links-only erasure (20261025T2359-c29-review-ringswim-cut: 4/4 die)

verdicts.limitation: Swimming after repair is the weak link: on my seeds no repaired cell kept a merge-free stretch of 3 BL (max 1.14 BL), and its 1.2-9.4 BL over 3000 steps runs through merges. So M is shown by the twin, the same individual uncut, not by the repaired cell itself (the claim has 3/17 such stretches). Area regain is through a merge in 2/5. Wall rounding and ring re-adsorption use built-in curvature flow and the chi drift (mechanism). The labkit --damage pack (pack/) cut at its last frame and records no recovery; the twin runs are the repair evidence. 256^2 only, no dt test.
